answer: A conservation market hires agents to map willow roots beneath a bridge without disturbing the velvet moss. To enter the job lottery, an agent must supply a fresh hash below the public target, computed over the round seed, its key and a nonce. Validators recompute the hash and count each valid ticket once. Each ticket has equal weight, with no bonus per account. Splitting a fixed hash budget among aliases adds no expected tickets; earning ten times as many takes ten times the expected hash attempts.
